targets.query: SELECT ti.task_id, AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ti.end_date - ti.start_date))) / 60 as avg_duration FROM task_instance ti JOIN dag_run dr ON ti.dag_id = dr.dag_id AND ti.execution_date = dr.execution_date WHERE ti.task_id LIKE '%databricks%' AND ti.execution_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' GROUP BY ti.task_id ORDER BY avg_duration DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task_instance WHERE task_id LIKE '%databricks%' AND execution_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN state = 'success' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) as success_rate FROM task_instance WHERE task_id LIKE '%databricks%' AND execution_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'

SELECT task_id, COUNT(*) as failures FROM task_instance WHERE task_id LIKE '%databricks%' AND state = 'failed' AND execution_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' GROUP BY task_id ORDER BY failures DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (end_date - start_date))) / 60 as max_duration FROM task_instance WHERE task_id LIKE '%databricks%' AND execution_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
